spans.s: व्यंसन n. fraud, deceit.
व्यंसयितव्य a. to be deceived.

व्यक्ति f. appearance, manifestation, distinctness, variety,
individual.

व्यग्र a. having no certain point or aim, unconcentrated,
distracted, perplexed, bewildered;
 quite occupied with, eagerly engaged
in (instr., loc., or —˚). Abstr. ˚ता f., ˚त्व n.

1 व्य॑ङ्ग a. spotted;
 m. spot, stain (lit. & fig.).

2 व्य॑ङ्ग a. limbless, mutilated, crippled;
 abstr. ˚ता† f.

व्यङ्गय् व्यङ्ग˚यति pp. व्यङ्गित rob of a limb,
mutilate, maim, cripple.
व्यङ्गारे (loc.) when there is no coal burning.
व्यङ्गिन् a. = 2 व्य॑ङ्ग.

व्यच् विव्यक्ति extend around, embrace, encompass. — सम्
= S.
व्य॑चस् n. compass, extent, space.
व्य॑चस्वन्त् a. capacious, extensive, large.
व्य॑चिष्ठ (superl.) extending far and wide.

व्यजन n. fanning;
 a fan (also ˚क n.).

व्य॑ञ्जन a. = prec. a. — f. आ indirect indication,
insinuation ((rh.)). n. manifestation, betrayal, indirect or implicit
expression, suggestion;
 mark, sign (esp. of gender or of puberty),
characteristic, attribute, the insignia of a prince, ornament i.g.,
condiment, sauce, juice;
 consonant, syllable.
व्य॑ति m. horse, steed.
व्यतिकरवन्त् a. mixed, altered, different.
व्यतिकरित a. mixed or joined with (instr. or —˚).
व्यतिक्रमण n. ˚क्रान्ति f. offence, injury.
व्यति˚क्रान्त n. ˚क्रान्ति f. offence, injury.
व्यतिमिश्र a. mixed, confounded.

व्यतिरेक m. separateness, exclusion, exception,
negation, contrast, opposite of (—˚).
व्य॑तिषक्त a. mixed, joined, connected.

व्यतिहार m. barter, exchange;
 mutuality, reciprocity.

व्यतीत a. gone, dead;
 passed over (act. & pass.).
व्यत्यय m. change, inverted order.
व्यत्यस्त a. inverted, crossed.
व्यत्यास m. transposition, change, reverse.

व्यथ् व्य॑थते (व्य॑थ˚ति), pp. व्यथित॑ (q.v.)
waver, reel, stagger, come to fall, go wrong, fail;
 tremble, be afraid
or pained. C. व्यथ॑यति cause to waver etc., bring to fall, make
afraid or uneasy, distress, pain. — प्र, संप्र, वि & सम् = S.
व्यथयितृ m. harasser (acc.).

व्य॑था f. failure, disappointment, misfortune, loss,
adversity, uneasiness, sorrow, distress.
†व्यथि v. सव्यथि॑.

व्यथित॑ a. wavering, agitated, disturbed, distressed;
n. agitation, pain, harm.

व्य॑थिस् a. wavering, reeling, sneaking, crooked,
mischievous, secret.
व्यद्वर॑ m. व्य॑द्वरी f. a gnawing animal.

व्यध् वि॑ध्यति (वि॑ध्य˚ते), pp. विद्ध॑ (q.v.)
pierce, hit, wound, hurt, harm, injure, affect or afflict with (instr.).
C. वेधयति pierce, hit, व्याधयति cause to pierce etc. — अति &
व्यति pierce, perforate. अनु pierce or wound (after another);
intertwine, set or fill with (instr.). अप hurl or throw away, give
up, neglect. अभि wound, hit. अव precipitate into (loc.) or from
(abl.). आ throw, bore or break through;
 scare, drive away, also
= व्या & समा wave, swing, brandish. नि throw down, overthrow;
shoot at, hit, pierce. निस् wound, kill, slay. परा hurl off wound,
hit. परि shoot at. प्र hurl, throw, shoot, perforate, wound.
प्रति shoot, hit. वि pierce, shoot. सम् shoot. — Cf. अनुविद्ध,
अपविद्ध, आ॑विद्ध, प्र॑विद्ध, व्यपविद्ध.
व्यध m. piercing, hitting, perforation.

व्याध m. hunter, abstr. ˚ता;
 p. ˚धिन्.
व्यधन a. & n. piercing, perforating.
व्य॑ध्वन् a. being midway or swerving from the way.
व्यध्वर॑ a. piercing, boring (cf. व्यद्वर॑).
व्य॑न्त a. separated, remote.
1 व्यन्तर n. interval, indistinctness.
2 व्यन्तर m. a class of supernatural beings.
व्यन्तरा॑म् adv. indifferently, moderately.
व्यपदेशवन्त् a. having a designation or name.
व्यपनय m. ˚न n. taking off, removing.
व्यपनुत्ति f. pushing away, removal.
व्यपयान n. retreat, flight.
व्यपरोपण n. tearing out, removing, destroying.

व्यपविद्ध a. thrown asunder or away, scattered,
broken, pierced, hit.

व्यपाय m. cessation, end;
 absence, want.
व्यपेत a. separated, ceased, vanished.

व्यपोह m. removal, expulsion;
 negation, denial.

व्यभ्र a. cloudless;
 loc. when the sky is clear.
व्यय् व्य˚यति व्य˚य˚ते waste, squander, expend.

व्यय m. going asunder, perishing, disappearance, loss,
destruction, waste, prodigality, expense, money.
व्ययकरण m. pay-master.
व्ययकरण˚क m. pay-master.
व्ययकर्मन् n. a pay-master's office.
व्ययकृत a. expended, disbursed.
व्ययगुण a. prodigal, dissipated.

व्य॑यन n. going away, parting;
 waste, expense.
व्यर्थता f. ˚त्व n. uselessness or senselessness.
व्य॑र्धुक a. being deprived of (instr.).
व्य॑ल्कशा f. N. of a plant.

†व्यवच्छेद m. getting rid of (—˚), separation,
distinction, interruption, exclusion.
व्यवच्छेद्य a. to be excluded.
व्यवधि m. covering, cover, veil.

व्यवसाय m. exertion, resolution, purpose, intention to
(loc., प्रति, or —˚).
व्यवसायवन्त् a. determined, resolute.
व्यव˚सायिन् a. determined, resolute.

व्यवसायात्मक f. ˚त्मिका of a resolute or
constant nature.
व्यवसित n. ˚सिति f. determination, resolve.

व्यवस्थान n. remaining, persevering, constancy;
state, condition.

व्यवस्थिति f. distinctness, particularity, constancy,
perseverance in (loc.), fixedness, decision.
व्यवहारक m. man of business.
व्यवहारतन्त्र n. judicial relation.

व्यवहारदर्शन n. judicial investigation,
trial.
व्यवहारपद n. ˚मार्ग m. case in law.
व्यवहारविधि m. judicial procedure, code of law.
व्यवहारस्थान n. case in law.
व्यवहारस्थिति f. judicial procedure.
व्यवहारार्थिन् a. having a lawsuit, accuser.
व्यवहार्य a. to be dealt or communicated with.

व्यवहित a. separated, interrupted, hindered,
disturbed.

व्यवहृति f. procedure, mode of acting, intercourse,
commerce, lawsuit.

व्यवाय m. intervention, separation by inserting,
penetration, coition.
व्यवायिन् a. intervening etc. (v. prec.).

व्य॑श्व a. horseless;
 m. N. of an ancient Ṛṣi.

व्य॑ष्टि f. acquisition, succession;
 individual (ph.).

व्यष्टिसमष्टिता f. the being individuality or
totality (ph.).
व्यसि a. swordless.

व्यसु a. breathless, lifeless, dead;
 abstr. ˚त्व n.
व्यस्तकेश f. ई॑ having dishevelled hair.
व्यस्थक a. boneless.
व्याकुली@कृ = prec., ˚भू P.
व्या॑कृति f. separation, analysis, explanation.
व्याकोश a. expanded, blossomed, open.
व्याक्रोश m. abusing, reviling.

व्याक्षेप m. = prec.;
 also distraction, absence of mind.
व्याक्षेपिन् a. dispelling, driving away.
व्याख्या f. explanation, commentary.
व्याख्यातव्य a. to be explained.
व्याख्यातृ m. explainer.

व्याख्या॑न f. ई explaining, reminding of (gen.) n.
explanation, recitation, story, tale.
व्याख्यानय् व्याख्यान˚यति explain, relate.*
व्याघारण n. sprinkling about ((r.)).
व्याघ्रचर्मन् n. a tiger's skin.
व्याघ्रलोम॑न् n. a tiger's hair.
व्याघ्र्य॑ a. a tiger's or tiger-like.
व्याजनिन्दा f. ironical censure.
व्याजमय f. ई feigned, simulated.
व्याजय् व्याज˚यति cheat, deceive.
व्याजसुप्त a. & n. feigning to sleep.
व्याजस्तुति f. ironical praise.
व्याड m. beast of prey.
व्याडि m. patron. of sev. men.
व्याळि m. patron. of sev. men.
व्यात्तानन a. open-mouthed.
व्यादान n. tearing asunder, opening.
व्यादेश m. hint, direction.

व्याध˚क m. hunter, abstr. ˚ता;
 p. ˚धिन्.

व्याधि m. disease;
 ˚त a. ill, sick.
व्या॑धी f. care, sorrow.
1 व्याधि॑न् a. piercing, perforating.
2 व्याधिन् v. व्याध.
व्याधिबहुल a. frequently visited by illness.
व्याध्यार्त a. visited by illness.

व्यान॑ m. breath, esp. the vital air diffused through the
whole body.
व्यानदा॑ a. giving breath.
व्यानम्र a. bent.
व्यानशि॑ a. pervading.
व्यानोदान॑ m. du. the Vyāna and Udāna.

व्यापक a. pervading, spread or diffused everywhere;

व्यापत्ति f. going amiss, ill luck, adversity, misfortune,
ruin, death.
व्यापद् f. = prec., also misdeed.
व्यापाद m. ruin, death.
व्यापादन n. destroying, killing.
व्यापार m. occupation, business, exertion, concern.
व्यापारिन् a. occupied with (—˚).
व्यापित a. = व्याप्त (—˚).
व्यापीत a. quite yellow.
व्यापित्व n. abstr. to seq.

व्यापृत a. active, busy, occupied with or in (—˚,
अर्थम् or हेतोस्).
व्यापृति f. occupation, activity.

व्याप्त a. pervaded or penetrated by, filled with (—˚);
acquired, won.
व्याप्तिमन्त् a. stretching, all-pervading, general.

व्याप्य a. that wherein something is contained or inherent;
abstr. ˚त्व n.
व्याभुग्न a. bent, curved.
व्याम॑ m. a fathom (lit. stretch -out).

व्यामिश्र a. mixed, mingled or joined with (instr. or —˚),
manifold, various.
व्यामूढ a. bewildered, perplexed, confused.

व्यामोह m. unconsciousness, bewilderment, error,
uncertainty.

व्यायामभूमि f. place or hall for gymnastic
exercise.
व्यायाम˚शाला f. place or hall for gymnastic exercise.
व्या॑युक a. running away.
व्यायुध a. weaponless, unarmed.
व्यायोग m. a kind of drama.

व्या॑ल a. mischievous, malicious. m. a malicious elephant,

व्यालग्राह (& ˚हिन्*) m. snake-catcher.
व्यालमृग m. beast of prey.
व्यालम्ब a. hanging down, pendulous.
व्या˚लम्बिन् a. hanging down, pendulous.
व्यालोल a. trembling, waving, unsteady.

व्याव॑र्तन f. ई = prec.;
 n. turning.
व्यावृ॑त् f. distinction, prevalence, superiority.

व्यासङ्ग m. attachment, adherence, desire of, delight in,
passion for (loc. or —˚).
व्यासेध m. hindrance, disturbance, interruption.
व्याहरण n. pronouncing, uttering.
